notification.label: Needs input
notification.desc: Blocked on a permission prompt or an input request — {{provider}} can't continue until you respond.

stop.label: Turn done
stop.desc: {{provider}} finished its reply; the session is idle until you send the next prompt.

session_start.label: At prompt
session_start.desc: The session just started or resumed and is sitting at an empty prompt — nothing has been asked yet.

interrupted.label: Interrupted
interrupted.desc: The last turn was interrupted (Esc or a recovered hook) — {{provider}} is waiting for direction.

help.title: About events, filters, and grouping
help.subtitle: Unlock deeper insights: badges, lifecycles, and filter mechanics explained.
help.valueStatusDesc: Preset shortcut that expands to event_type values (Working → PreToolUse, Completed → Stop/SessionEnd/codex_task_complete, ...).
help.valueEventTypeDesc: Raw event_type strings from the DB. Pulled from /api/events/facets.
help.valueToolNameDesc: tool_name values currently in the DB (Bash, Edit, Read, Grep, mcp__... tools). Pulled from /api/events/facets.
help.valueAgentIdDesc: Full agent UUIDs (main + subagents). Select one or more to scope to specific agents.
help.valueSessionIdDesc: Session UUIDs. Typically you'd navigate to /sessions/:id instead, but this lets you intersect multiple sessions.
help.valueSearchDesc: Substring match on summary, tool_name, and the raw JSON payload. Debounced 300ms.
help.valueDateRangeDesc: ISO datetime lower/upper bounds on the event's created_at.
help.statusesIntro: Status is derived from event_type. It's what you see on each row.
help.statusWorkingDesc: Work is starting or under way: a prompt was submitted, a Codex turn began, or a tool is about to run (PreToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, codex_user_message, codex_task_started, codex_tool_call).
help.statusWaitingDesc: A tool returned and the turn continues, or the event is lifecycle/metadata with no reliable progress meaning (PostToolUse, the codex_*_end tool results, SessionStart, Notification, TurnDuration, codex_turn_aborted). Metadata events keep the Waiting badge but are deliberately left out of the Waiting filter preset, which matches only tool results.
help.statusCompletedDesc: Turn or lifecycle boundary (Stop, SessionEnd, SubagentStop, Compaction, codex_task_complete, codex_context_compacted).
help.statusErrorDesc: An error was recorded (error, APIError, codex_error).
help.lifecycleDesc: A typical tool call emits two events sharing the same tool_use_id:
help.filterTip1: Filters compose with AND across categories. Within one category, multi-select is OR.
help.filterTip2: Status is a shortcut that expands to event_type values (Working → PreToolUse, Completed → Stop/SessionEnd/codex_task_complete, ...). Status + Event type compose as OR on event_type.
help.filterTipGrouping: Grouping tip: a grouped row needs both Pre and Post events. If you filter by Status, pick Working + Waiting together to keep pairs intact - otherwise a group will only show half of the call.
help.filterTip3: Text search matches summary, tool_name, and the raw payload (data column).
help.filterTip4: Date range applies to each event's created_at.
